text: @trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold 是面向 DSH Web 界面的折叠体验插件，通过 bundle patch 将客户端插件接入 overlay，并加载全局样式。它让展开的 Think 推理折叠行在会话滚动区域顶部保持可见，读完长内容后无需回到顶部寻找折叠按钮；点击、按 Enter 或空格折叠已展开的 Think 内容时，还会补偿滚动位置，让折叠行回到视口顶部。插件只注册客户端 slots.overlay 项，节点端不提供服务或工具。适合使用 Web 界面阅读长推理内容的用户；代码中未见 API key 或外部服务要求。

@trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold keeps the Think fold row visible at the top of the DSH Web conversation while long reasoning content is expanded. After a click, Enter, or Space folds it, the plugin adjusts scrolling to keep the row at the viewport top. It adds a client overlay and stylesheet.
读很长的推理内容时，想让折叠按钮一直留在屏幕上。
展开的 Think 内容看完收起后，能不能让页面停留在原来的阅读位置？
Keep the reasoning fold control visible while I scroll through a long response.
@trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold 的功能「固定 Think 折叠行」：展开 Think 推理内容时，将其折叠行固定在会话滚动区域顶部，长内容滚动阅读时仍可见；内容整体滚出区域后固定状态自动结束。
@trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold 的功能「折叠后滚动补偿」：点击折叠行或按 Enter、空格收起已展开的 Think 内容后，监听器等待界面更新并调整滚动位置，使折叠行回到视口顶部。

@trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold README · @trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Easy-fold plugin for the dsh Web GUI: two browser-side behaviors that keep long expanded content easy to read and fold.

@trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold README · Problem：Some disclosure components have a reading ergonomics problem: when the folded content is very long, expanding it and scrolling down to read carries the fold button out of the screen; to collapse the content again, the user must first scroll back to the top of the content to reach the button, interrupting their reading position.

@trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold README · What the plugin does：- **Sticky fold row** — while the content is expanded, the fold row pins to the top of the conversation scrollport, staying visible and clickable during reading; the pin releases by itself once the whole content has scrolled out, without changing the layout.
- **Collapse scroll compensation** — folding a pinned component (click, Enter, or Space on the row) pulls the scrollport back to the fold row's position — the spot the pinned row occupied. The viewport stays at the component node instead of landing below it; a fold of a row already inside the viewport stays exactly in place.

@trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold README · Affected UI components：| Component                          | Status      |
| ---------------------------------- | ----------- |
| Think (reasoning fold row)         | Implemented |
| Other long-content fold components | Planned     |

@trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold README · Install：Requires a dsh deployment with the Web surface. Install into the profile you use for `pnpm dsh web`:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add @trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold
```

`pnpm dsh plugin add` installs the package into the profile and registers its bundle patch layer automatically (the profile manifest's `dsh.profile.bundles` gains the entry). Restart `pnpm dsh web` to compose the new row, then open the Web page.

To uninstall:

@trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold README · Develop：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build    # emits lib/index.js and lib/client.js (ModuleLoader handoff)

The client bundle resolves `react` from the dsh Web loader's platform module table; the package declares no other runtime dependencies. To test a local checkout before publishing, install it by path or tarball:

```sh
pnpm pack
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add ./trujaycc-dsh-ui-easyfold-0.1.0.tgz
```
@trujaycc/dsh-ui-easyfold README · Model Experience：None. Presentation-only client plugin: no host services, tools, or session events; nothing reaches a model request or the session log.
